name: Japanese Folklore Tales
description: "Manga Nippon Mukashibanashi" was a series running from 1975 to 1994 (with a short stop) in japanese tv. Each episode contained 1 to 3 short folk tales from the rich tradition of Japanese storytelling. Ghosts, samurai, goddesses, famous doomed romances, wandering heroes, legendary creatures, mysterious magical visitors... all presented in a simple cartoon style which varies from silly to quite charming.

videos.title: Slapped!
videos.overview: A woman wants her cheating beau back; a lady discovers that her man is cheating on her with a woman who has the same first name as she does. Also: a lesbian love triangle that includes charges of stalking.
